verdict_reason: The import swap is correct, but the actor helpers remain copied across outbox specs and one test title over-claims 'immediately'.

todos.issue: Beside the aggregateIdFor promotion, EXPECTED_ACTOR (13-20) and actorWithNullableFields (22-29) are left as line-for-line copies of outbox-event-amendment.spec.ts:10-26 (and the same pair in outbox-event-notification.spec.ts). Test set-up used by several specs is copied rather than living in the shared helper.
todos.fix: Must: the expected actor for users.andrew and the actor-normalising function each live once in shared test support, and every outbox spec imports them. One way: move both next to aggregateIdFor in domain/animals/models/db/outbox-event-document.ts (or a flows helper) and delete the local copies in created, amendment and notification specs.

todos.issue: The title 'writes a NotificationCreated event immediately on draft creation' claims 'immediately', but the test polls for up to timeouts.long (47-49) before asserting, so it passes however late the event is written. The assertions prove the event exists with the given fields, not when it was written.
todos.fix: Must: the title states only what the assertions prove. One way: 'writes a NotificationCreated event on draft creation'.
